_comment: vendored-remote-resources, whose lane needs a VERIFIED vendor result: this fixture is the one that supplies it. lib/theme.css matches the bytes its declared source serves and the package is popular, so the file is that release's - and the remote @import on its first line is the release's own line, not something the developer wrote. So remote-resources does NOT report it as a finding; vendored-remote-resources puts it to a person instead, who decides whether shipping the release as published is acceptable. The locus carries the release it was matched against as its hint. Escalations are not expressible in `expect`, so the golden holds it.
